title: DMW: PH, Luxembourg eye labor pact to open more jobs for Filipinos

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines and Luxembourg are exploring a labor cooperation agreement that could open up more overseas employment opportunities for skilled Filipino workers in the European country, the Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) said on Saturday. The proposed Joint Declaration of Intent (JDI) on labor cooperation seeks to expand job opportunities for overseas Filipino workers (OFWs) while ensuring ethical recruitment, fair employment arrangements, and adequate protection of their rights and welfare. The proposal was discussed during a Nov. 6 meeting between Migrant Workers Secretary Hans Leo Cacdac, Luxembourg Honorary Consul in the Philippines Lutz Kunack, and Minister-Counsellor Anne Moes, […]...
